:::{#exm-truth-table}
#### A truth table for $P \Rightarrow Q$

The proposition $P \Rightarrow Q$ is built from two propositions,
so its truth table has $2^2 = 4$ rows.
By the definition of [implies](#def-implies),
$P \Rightarrow Q$ is false only in the row where $P$ is true and $Q$ is false:

| $P$ | $Q$ | $P \Rightarrow Q$ |
|:---:|:---:|:-----------------:|
| T   | T   | T                 |
| T   | F   | F                 |
| F   | T   | T                 |
| F   | F   | T                 |

:::
